questions.questionText: In an algorithm counting element frequencies in an array of size N using nested loops, what is the primary role of the outer loop?
options: Sorts the input array in descending numerical order before frequency counting begins
Counts all duplicate occurrences across the entire array in a single constant-time pass
Stores the running frequencies directly into an auxiliary hash set without iterations
Iterates through each element one by one to select it as the current target to count
questions.correctAnswer: Iterates through each element one by one to select it as the current target to count
questions.explanation: Derived directly from session evidence for Relationship between sampling frequency and time interval. Correct option reflects taught behavior; distractors embody plausible misconceptions.

questions.questionText: Given an array arr = [3, 1, 3] processed by nested loops for frequency counting, what is the recorded frequency of the element 3 after the first outer loop pass (i = 0)?
options: 3, because the inner loop counts all elements regardless of value
2, because the inner loop matches arr[0] at indices 0 and 2
0, because frequency counters initialize only after all iterations finish
1, because the inner loop only counts occurrences strictly after index i
questions.correctAnswer: 2, because the inner loop matches arr[0] at indices 0 and 2
questions.explanation: Derived directly from session evidence for Spectral resolution calculation. Correct option reflects taught behavior; distractors embody plausible misconceptions.
